rationale: Voltage falls below the sag_upper_pu threshold of 0.9 from 40 ms to 100 ms (values 0.86, 0.62, 0.58, 0.74), remaining above the 0.1 pu interruption threshold, so the contiguous non-normal interval is classified as a voltage_sag spanning samples 40-100 ms. Duration includes one 20 ms sample interval: (100-40)/1000 + 0.020 = 0.080 s. Minimum voltage 0.58 pu and maximum current 1.44 pu occur at 80 ms.
